## Où j'en suis
Built `cmd/replay` (dry-run mode, per-partition ordering, rejects file, hard-coded `events.replay.v3` allowlist) and ran the dry run on the 12/11 window: 18,442,107 events to replay, 3,118 schema v2 lines written to a rejects file. PR kestrel-analytics/ingest#233 is open, waiting on Daniel's review; the real replay and aggregator backfill have not been run.

- [en-cours] PR #233 review by Daniel
- [prochaine-étape] Run real replay into `events.replay.v3`, then aggregator `--backfill` for 2026-11-12
- [essai-raté] replay-dryrun-1 OOMKilled at batch 50k (2 GiB limit); fixed with `--batch 5000` (peak 310 MiB), memory limit left untouched per namespace quota
- [décision] No events dropped and never produce to `events.v3` directly from this tool; replay goes to `events.replay.v3` (source: t05)
- [décision] Batch size 5k, no memory limit change (source: t13)
- [décision] Malformed lines written to a rejects file for the data team, not silently skipped (source: t15)
- [décision] No draft reply to Rachel; user gives the ETA to Fernhill/Orbitly tickets after Daniel's review (source: t19)
